## What changed

*One or two plain sentences naming the files or folders this branch touches, and what is different in them.*

## Why

*The reason in your own words, with the plan section, GitHub issue (a to-do item on the repository) or decision note it follows, if there is one.*

## For the reviewer

*Where to look first in the diff (the list of lines added and removed), and anything you cannot yet explain out loud (rule 3 in the guide, chapter 0).*
